title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The final values for B and n must be correctly stated as B = 2A and n = 3.

title: Use of First Law
description: Important Criteria: The application of the first law of thermodynamics to derive the expression for dS must be correctly shown.

title: Differential Condition
description: Important Criteria: The condition for dS to be a complete differential must be correctly identified and set up.

title: Partial Derivatives
description: Important Criteria: The correct calculation of the partial derivatives with respect to T and V must be performed accurately.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of the logarithmic properties in the derivation will lead to a deduction.
